assets.name: 炎竜の槍士
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset: one fully HUMAN character skin, full-body transparent illustration for children's fantasy RPG.
Inputs1–4: PRIMARY STYLE references, original illustrations drawn by the user. Capture their shape construction and face/expression language, not just texture: slightly uneven warm red-brown pencil contours with pressure variation, soft rounded face, readable vertical oval eyes with modest highlights, simple tiny nose, cheek marks, distinctive brows and mouth, broad angular hair tufts, lively unpretentious children's storybook gesture. Broad flat pastel/colored-pencil color patches, subtle interior grain, short loose hatched shadows. Reinterpret the author's animal expressions/tufts as human eyes, posture and hair. User portrait shows face tenderness, forest comic shows rough pencil shadow strokes and freely brushed soft fill. Do not copy animal anatomy.
Input5: existing character to REDRAW. Preserve identity, hair/eye colors, main outfit silhouette and colors, signature accessories, role and held equipment. It is ONLY a DESIGN reference, NOT a rendering reference: discard all pixel stair steps, glossy anime gacha gradients, metallic polish, dense micro-ornaments and perfect vector-like lines. Draw freshly from user's original hand rather than smoothing the target or merely adding pencil grain.
Medium: NON-PIXEL freehand digital pencil-and-pastel illustration, warm brown irregular outline, 3–4 broad shades per material, short confident hatching, warm expressive human face. Around 3-head cartoon proportions; distinguish this character's personality, not the same open-mouthed boy face on everyone. Detail hierarchy favors face and silhouette. A few LARGE readable ornaments retain identity without dense filigree. Practical modest full coverage appropriate to children's game.
Composition: square1:1, single full-body character, slight three-quarter front angle, whole hair/crown/feet/clothes/weapon/accessory inside canvas with at least 6–8% safe breathing margin. Dynamic but balanced pose. Actual alpha transparency, ALL empty spaces outside/within silhouette transparent. NO backdrop, paper rectangle, checkerboard painted into image, diffuse halo, vignette, ground shadow, floor, frame, text, labels, watermark, companions, extra characters, animal ears/tail/muzzle. No pixel art, visible square clusters, 3D, photorealism, dense jewel ornamentation or glossy lighting effects.
Subject: existing 炎竜の槍士 in image5. Fully HUMAN young male lancer; black tousled hair with a bold red forelock, warm fiery amber eyes, spirited confident grin, cheek marks. Preserve charcoal-black and deep red practical armor, a few broad warm-gold edges, red scarf and streaming red cloth tails, plain leather boots, long dark spear with a dragon/flame-shaped red-and-gold spearhead and ONE orange-red gem. Simplify excessive small gold filigree into broad lines. Braced wide low attacking lunge, both hands grip spear diagonally forward; hair/scarf follow turn, face readable. Only two small loose orange brushstrokes near spear tip as fire accent, not rings of flames or glow around body. Sword not needed. Entire spear and all clothing/feet inside square with margin. Friendly fierce storybook human, not shiny gacha anime.

assets.name: 木の剣
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: ONE existing RPG weapon redrawn as a NON-PIXEL hand-drawn equipment illustration in the user's own touch.
Images1–4 are the user's OWN original drawings: PRIMARY STYLE only. Observe warm reddish chocolate-brown irregular pencil outlines, natural pressure changes and loose short diagonal hatching; broad simple rounded/pointed storybook shapes and softly brushed colored-pencil/pastel flat color with restrained interior grain. Draw the OBJECT as the original children's-book illustrator would draw a prop. Style is NOT a generic polished fantasy weapon with texture added. NO pixel clusters, dithering, stair-step grid, 3D, realistic shiny metal or glossy anime light effects. Bold readable silhouette, few broad material shades, deliberate simple hand-drawn wood/metal/fabric forms, warm color harmony.
Image5 is existing weapon DESIGN only. Preserve its silhouette family, signature motifs, main colors and role, while simplifying tiny filigree into readable large pencil shapes. Discard pixel rendering and excessive glow. Object only, no human, hand or wearer.
Composition: 1:1 square, full weapon fully inside, generous 8% transparent breathing margin, fill about82% of canvas diagonally. Single-bladed weapons and staffs point UPPER RIGHT, grip LOWER LEFT. Dual blades may cross symmetrically. Genuine alpha transparency; no paper rectangle, drawn checkerboard, vignette, diffuse matte, broad opaque glow, ground/shadow, card, border, text, labels, watermarks, extra objects or new unrelated weapons. Texture ONLY inside the object. Weapon illustration only, usable isolated icon.
Subject: existing 木の剣. A simple pale honey-colored wooden training sword, broad blunt leaf-like wooden blade, ONE large oval wood knot with a few long loose pencil grain marks, straight wooden crossguard, dark brown leather-wrapped grip and simple wooden pommel. Charming worn hand-carved toy/training tool, chunky readable geometry and a few hatched shadows. No metal edge, gems, fire or magical effects. Blade upper-right, grip lower-left. Preserve plain low-tier feel.
